Sub: Outcome of Board meeting of Tata Steel Limited 
 
This has reference to our intimation of meeting of the Board of Directors of Tata Steel Limited 
(‘Company’) dated October 24, 2026. 
 
The Board of Directors (‘Board’) of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e.  
November 7, 2026, inter alia, transacted the following business: 
 
1. Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Considered and approved the Audited Standalone and Unaudited Consolidated Financial 
Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
The financial information as required to be provided in terms of Regulations 33 and 52 of the 
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’) forms part of the Financial Results. 
 
A copy of the said Financial Results together with the Statutory Auditors’ Report (with modified 
opinion) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, is enclosed herewith as 
Annexure A. Response to the Statutory Auditor’s opinion is provided in point no. 4 of the 
Notes to the Financial Results forming part of the SEBI Release enclosed in Annexure A. 
 
2. Retirement of Mr. Noel Naval Tata as the Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director 
and Vice Chairman of the Board  
 
In accordance with the Tata Group Governance Guidelines, Mr. Noel Naval Tata  
(DIN: 00024713) will retire as the Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice 
Chairman of the Board, effective close of business hours on November 11, 2026. 
 
Mr. Tata has been associated with the Company since March 2022 and during his tenure, he 
has provided valuable guidance and strategic direction to the Company. The Board places on 
record its deep appreciation for his invaluable contributions to the Company.
